# Repository discovery settings

These values are the intended GitHub repository-level settings for the Power Design Toolkit project.

> This file is source-controlled because GitHub repository metadata is not represented in the Git tree.  Apply these values in repository Settings when repository-administration tooling is available.

## Repository name

`power-design-toolkit`

## Description

`Open-source power electronics CAE toolkit for LLC, PFC, FRA, digital control, C99 code generation and switching verification.`

## Topics

- `power-electronics`
- `llc`
- `pfc`
- `vienna-pfc`
- `digital-control`
- `fra`
- `c2000`
- `embedded`
- `ngspice`
- `python`

## Product name

Keep the user-facing product name independent of the repository slug:

**Power Design Toolkit**

## Rename checklist

After the GitHub repository is renamed, verify:

- clone/remotes and CI badges resolve through GitHub's rename redirect;
- release/download links resolve;
- external deployment/webhook references are updated if any do not follow redirects;
- README badges are changed to the canonical new repository URL after the rename;
- local development remotes are updated to avoid relying indefinitely on redirects.
